STATE (as of March 16 2026):

WORKING:
- Custom server.ts wraps Next.js + WebSocket on port 3000
- Real Claude Code sessions register via hooks and appear as pixel workers
- Workers animate (typing/reading/idle/walking) based on real tool calls
- Risky commands (git push, rm, sudo) block until browser approve/deny
- No-browser fallthrough: if no WS clients, hook exits 0 (Claude Code handles in terminal)
- Worker click popup: details, recent tool history, cwd, session duration
- shfmt AST-based bash classifier (src/lib/tool-classifier.ts)
- Stale session cleanup: session-end based (not time-based timeout)
- Worker names: Pixel/Byte/Cache/Queue/Stack

BROKEN:
1. Auto-approve returns {} — must return explicit permissionDecision: 'allow'
2. iTerm2 focus opens app but doesn't switch to correct tab
3. tty from hook subprocess may not match iTerm2 session tty

NEXT: Fix auto-approve response format first (src/app/api/hooks/pre-tool-use/route.ts)
